name: Kevin Kinne
seat: Congress member; chairs Academic Affairs and Student Opinion Poll committees
note: Moved that the secretary send Congress's official congratulations to Coach Feix and the football team for the 1980 OVC championship, seconded and passed (11 Nov 1980 minutes). Chairs both the Academic Affairs and Student Opinion Poll committees throughout the year.

name: Shawn Bryant
note: Moved a floor motion, seconded and passed (7 Oct 1980 minutes); reported for the Housing Committee through 29 Jan 1981; nominated for the Dero Downing Award, 31 Mar 1981.

name: Osama Shariff
seat: Congress member; chairs International Students Committee
note: Chairs the International Students committee continuously from 2 Sept 1980 through 17 Feb 1981, organizing International Week; spelled Shariff and Sharif across different minutes. Nominated for Outstanding Congress Member, 31 Mar 1981.

name: Perry Hines
seat: Congress member; Representative-at-Large; chairs Minority Affairs Committee
note: Appointed Representative-at-Large by President Fuller with the consent of Congress, 11 Nov 1980; chairs the Minority Affairs committee from November. Ran for Freshman Class President and lost, 243 votes to John Holland's 114, 5 Nov 1980.

name: Margaret Ragan
seat: Congress member; chairs Complaint and Suggestion Committee
note: Chairs the Complaint and Suggestion committee from 7 Oct 1980; appointed student member to the University Academic Complaint Committee by President Fuller with the consent of Congress, 17 Feb 1981; nominated for Outstanding Congress Member, 31 Mar 1981. Name spelled Ragan, Ragen, Raden and Racan across different scans, all the same committee chair. A Margaret Ragan is separately recorded in years.json as the elected 1982-83 ASG president; nothing in either year's sourced record connects the two directly, so no identity is asserted here.
